title: Cyrus and the Will
author: Wren Amberdale
blurb: Orsen Brightwater, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
